scope.summary: DATA-005 current-head PR admission for the approved static data substrate operator, GitOps, and OpenSLO skeleton slice.
explicit_non_claims: No controller binary or runtime reconciliation loop is asserted; the Deployment remains replicas=0 with a contract-only image reference.
No database migration, tenant traffic, live Argo CD sync, production readiness, measured SLO window, or rollout claim is introduced.
The OpenSLO artifact records an evidence-required skeleton only; ADR-0139 promotion remains blocked until measured evidence and burn-rate receipts exist.
Pre-existing dirty workspace changes outside the DATA-005 branch/worktree were not reviewed as part of this changeset.

facets.F2_correctness: Adds the DATA-005 static operator/GitOps/OpenSLO skeleton with namespace-scoped RBAC, a zero-replica Deployment, an Argo CD Application without automated sync, and evidence-required OpenSLO metadata.
facets.F3_security: RBAC is namespace-scoped, service account token automount is disabled, pod securityContext drops all capabilities and uses RuntimeDefault seccomp, and no secrets or credentials are introduced.
facets.F4_data_boundary: The slice is metadata and manifest-only for the data substrate control plane; no tenant data, migrations, query execution, or production traffic path is added.
facets.F5_testing: Focused YAML parsing, kustomize renders, kubeconform schema checks, SLO evidence checker, git diff --check, accounting justification/reachability preflight, added-line secret scan, and semantic non-claim assertions are run before closeout and recorded on Kanban.
facets.F6_rollback: Revert the DATA-005 branch commit to remove the static data/ops manifests, OpenSLO skeleton, ADR/reachability registration, and this evidence packet; no runtime state rollback is required because no live sync or controller was enabled.
facets.F7_operability: Future runtime/operator work must supply controller image, CRDs, measured SLO windows, burn-rate receipts, audit correlation, and progressive-delivery evidence before changing the non-claim posture.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime code path is executed; the OpenSLO target is a future measurement contract only.
facets.F9_compliance: Maintains ADR-0139 fail-closed SLO-gated promotion language and avoids production-readiness or measured-SLO overclaim.
facets.F10_reversibility: All changes are additive static manifests/evidence plus explicit ADR/reachability accounting under DATA-005 scoped paths and can be reverted without schema, migration, or committed generated-face settlement.
facets.F11_observability: OpenSLO evidence-required metadata and Kanban closeout capture the required future telemetry proof before any promotion claim.
facets.F13_migration: This settles a previously reviewed skeleton into the protected PR lane; runtime/operator implementation remains deferred to a later DATA-005 successor card.
